ios.desc:
Testing user experience has never been so convenient. You no longer have to blind guess how potential users think about your app.

- Our specially built scanner allows extracting multiple sketches in one go
-  Supports wide range of interactions and gestures, giving a close to real experience to validate your design ideas.
- Storyboard let you get an overview of how screens are organized and linkages between each page.
- With Dropbox support, you can share your design with teammates with just a few taps.

To get started, all you need is simply an idea, pen, paper, and Team Proto.

1. Draw your app screen on paper, take photos using Team Proto (protip: Team Proto can capture multiple screen in one take)
2. Arrange and link screen in your favourite order. Get an overall idea in the storyboard
3. You are ready to who a playable prototype to others. Have fun show your latest app ideas.
